paragraphs: A Jaguar AJ27 engine rebuild starts from £3,600, regardless of which of the six models it's fitted to — the price tier is set by the engine, not the badge on the boot. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available.
Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Jaguar already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most AJ27 owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six AJ27-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Jaguar AJ27 engine?
faqLeft.a: The AJ27 is Jaguar's 4.0-litre naturally aspirated V8 petrol engine, part of the AJ-V8 family that powered Jaguar's flagship models through the late 1990s and early 2000s.

faqLeft.q: Which Jaguar models use the AJ26/AJ27?
faqLeft.a: XJ XJ8 (X308, 1997–2003) and XK XK8 (X100, 1996–2004). The supercharged AJ27S is used in the XKR.

faqLeft.q: Does the AJ27 differ between Jaguar models?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The naturally aspirated AJ27 differs from the supercharged AJ27S, and ancillaries, ECU calibration, and mounting vary between the XJ and XK applications.

faqLeft.q: Is an AJ27 from one Jaguar model compatible with another?
faqLeft.a: Not automatically. A naturally aspirated AJ27 from an XJ isn't a drop-in match for a supercharged AJ27S from an XKR — and even between naturally aspirated applications, mounting and ancillaries differ.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar AJ27 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £4,500 for naturally aspirated variants, with supercharged AJ27S applications at the same starting price tier plus additional supercharger-specific work.

faqLeft.q: What are the common issues with the AJ26/AJ27?
faqLeft.a: Timing chain tensioner failure is the most significant known issue — plastic tensioners fail and primary guides crack and break off. Early engines also suffered from Nikasil cylinder lining issues with high-sulphur fuel; later engines use cast-iron linings.

faqRight.a: Yes. We work on AJ26 and AJ27 rebuilds across both the XJ and XK applications, replacing worn components as standard and thoroughly inspecting the timing chain system.

faqRight.q: Do you work on supercharged AJ27S engines?
faqRight.a: Yes. The AJ27S in the XKR is within our workshop capability, with the supercharger system inspected and serviced alongside the standard rebuild scope.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Jaguar AJ27 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Jaguar if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an AJ27 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most AJ27 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history — a particular concern for these engines given the timing chain tensioner issues that affect early examples — and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
